tools.name: moosend_list_mailing_lists
tools.description: List the active email (mailing) lists in the account with member counts (active, bounced, removed, unsubscribed), custom field definitions and preferences, plus paging info. A cheap way to confirm the API key works and to find list IDs. Moosend: GET /lists/{Page}/{PageSize}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_mailing_list
tools.description: Get one mailing list: name, member counts, status, custom field definitions (id, name, type, required), preferences and the latest import operation. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/details.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers of one mailing list filtered by status (Subscribed, Unsubscribed, Bounced or Removed), with name, email, custom fields, tags, preferences and dates. Paged. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/subscribers/{Status}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_subscriber_by_email
tools.description: Look up a subscriber in one mailing list by email address: ID, name, status (SubscribeType 1 subscribed, 2 unsubscribed, 3 bounced, 4 removed), custom fields, tags and preferences. Moosend: GET /subscribers/{MailingListID}/view.json?Email=.

tools.name: moosend_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber in a mailing list by subscriber ID. Moosend: GET /subscribers/{MailingListID}/find/{SubscriberID}.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_segments
tools.description: List the segments of one mailing list, including their criteria, match type (0 all / 1 any) and a readable description. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_segment
tools.description: Get one segment's details and criteria (not its members). Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments/{SegmentID}/details.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_segment_subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers that currently match one segment's criteria. Moosend: GET /lists/{MailingListID}/segments/{SegmentID}/members.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns with status (0 draft, 1 queued, 3 sent, 5 awaiting delivery, 6 sending, ...), delivery/schedule dates, target lists and headline stats (sent, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, complaints). Paged, up to 1000 per page. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{Page}/{PageSize}.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign's details: subject, sender and reply-to, HTML and plain content, target lists/segments, schedule, status and A/B data. No statistics (use moosend_get_campaign_summary). Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/view.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_summary
tools.description: Get a sent campaign's results to date: sent, total/unique opens, total/unique link clicks, bounces, complaints, forwards and unsubscribes. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/view_summary.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_activity
tools.description: Per-recipient activity for a campaign by type: Sent, Opened, LinkClicked, Unsubscribed, Bounced, Complained, or Activity (all). Paged (default 50, max 1000) and filterable by date. NOTE: Moosend rate-limits this endpoint to 2 calls per 60 seconds per API key. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/sta

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_link_activity
tools.description: List every link in a campaign with its total and unique click counts. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/stats/links.json.

tools.name: moosend_get_campaign_activity_by_location
tools.description: A campaign's total and unique opens broken down by country code. Moosend: GET /campaigns/{CampaignID}/stats/countries.json.

tools.name: moosend_list_senders
tools.description: List the account's campaign senders (name, email, enabled, SPF/DKIM verification). A draft campaign's sender and reply-to must be one of these. Moosend: GET /senders/find_all.json.

tools.name: moosend_create_mailing_list
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty mailing list. Returns the new list's ID. Moosend: POST /lists/create.json.

tools.name: moosend_add_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add one subscriber to a mailing list. If the email already exists in the list, that subscriber is UPDATED instead (and custom fields you omit are cleared). A previously unsubscribed address is re-subscribed. Rate limit 10 calls / 10 s. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/subscribe.json

tools.name: moosend_update_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: update one subscriber (by ID) in a mailing list — email, name, custom fields, tags, preferences. Include every custom field you want to keep. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/update/{SubscriberID}.json.

tools.name: moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe one email address from one mailing list (not account-wide). Undo by adding the subscriber again with moosend_add_subscriber. Moosend: POST /subscribers/{MailingListID}/unsubscribe.json.

tools.name: moosend_create_draft_campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create a regular (non-A/B) DRAFT campaign. It is NOT sent — sending stays a human action in Moosend. Give the content as html_content or a web_location URL. sender_email and reply_to_email must be senders in the account (see moosend_list_senders). Returns the new campaign's ID. Moosend: POST

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_list_subscribers, moosend_get_subscriber_by_email, moosend_get_campaign, moosend_list_senders, moosend_create_mailing_list, moosend_add_subscriber, moosend_update_subscriber, moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber · Private data: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_get_campaign_activity · Public sink: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_list_subscribers, moosend_get_subscriber_by_email, moosend_list_senders, moosend_create_mailing_list, moosend_add_subscriber, moosend_update_subscriber, moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber, moosend_create_draft_campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_list_subscribers, moosend_get_subscriber_by_email, moosend_get_campaign, moosend_list_senders, moosend_create_mailing_list, moosend_add_subscriber, moosend_update_subscriber, moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber · Private data: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_get_campaign_activity · Public sink: moosend_list_mailing_lists, moosend_list_subscribers, moosend_get_subscriber_by_email, moosend_list_senders, moosend_create_mailing_list, moosend_add_subscriber, moosend_update_subscriber, moosend_unsubscribe_subscriber, moosend_create_draft_campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
